title: Investors, Take Note: Hair Loss Could Be Biotech's Next Weight-Loss-Drug-Sized Blockbuster
summary: Lilly has placed a $40 million bet on next-generation hair-loss drugs. With roughly 80 million U.S. patients still constrained by two legacy therapies, AH-001's Phase 2 data could become the next global asset-revaluation trigger.
